lead: A new `CoreTy` variant is one edit in `registry.rs` and four outside it.
body: The enum is `#[non_exhaustive]`, which does nothing inside its own crate, so `ast.rs`'s `mentions` walk and `xml.rs`'s two — `mentions` and `every_text_position_is_tainted` — and `nvs-types`' `core_lib::lower` all stop compiling, while `classification`, `spelled` and `is_text_like` in `registry.rs` itself keep compiling and quietly answer wrong for the new spelling. Grep a rare variant (`CoreTy::SecretTaintedStr`) to get every arm in one call rather than chasing the compiler through them one at a time, and check the three `registry.rs` methods by hand.
